reason: The carrier appears central to transferring the specimens, but its required preparation is not yet clear.
expectation: Its compatible partners should show how to begin the cold transfer.

effect: The carrier is chilled and has two cradles for the complete core liners.
reaction: The emphasis on preserving the surrounding ice makes the transfer feel purposeful.
reason: The conditioned carrier is ready to receive a core, so I will start with the stored source core.
expectation: The source core will be secured in one of the chilled cradles.

effect: The source core is in the first compartment, leaving the second ready for the band core.
reaction: It's reassuring that the original liner stays intact.
reason: The second compartment should hold the other complete core.
expectation: The band core will be secured in the remaining chilled compartment.

effect: Both complete core liners are now packed separately in the chilled carrier, ready for flight cooling.
reaction: Keeping the two locations distinct makes the collection feel meaningful.
reason: The packed cores should now be transferred to the refrigerated flight bay.
expectation: Both cores will be secured on flight cooling.

effect: Both cores are secured on active flight cooling; the first membrane specimen still needs to be brought aboard.
reaction: The buffered transfer provides a reassuring continuity of cooling.
reason: The separate first specimen should go into the flight specimen locker.
expectation: The membrane specimen will be secured for the journey.

effect: The original membrane specimen is secured separately, completing both transfer goals.
reaction: Its separate padded restraint is a fitting acknowledgment of the first discovery.

mostWorthwhile.text: Packing both intact cores and connecting their carrier to flight cooling was most worthwhile: the separate liners preserve their contexts, and the buffer explains how they stay cold during transfer.

leastWorthwhile.text: Loading the two cores was straightforward and somewhat repetitive, though the separate compartments had a clear purpose.

surprise.text: Inspecting the carrier automatically chilled it at the bench; I expected compatibility information rather than an immediate transformation.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary. The initial carrier preparation was not obvious beforehand, but its cooling buffer and cradles made its purpose clear afterward.

continue.text: Yes. The careful preservation of the specimens makes me curious what the receiving laboratories will discover, although this chapter's choices were mostly straightforward.
